images.prompt: A ceiling void above a suspended-tile grid in a large commercial building, viewed at an angle from below: structural steel, cable tray, conduit runs, and one wireless access point still sitting unmounted in its bracket on the tray. Cream light picks out the steel edges and the tile grid. The single red element is the small indicator on the access point. Architectural and quiet. Deep dark navy dominates every surface and every background plane — never blue, never cyan, no teal anywhere. Soft cream (#F4EFE3) is the only highlight. Exactly one red element in the entire image, nothing else is red. Absolutely no text, no letterforms, no numerals, no signage, no logos, no vendor marks on any faceplate or panel. No tick-mark numerals. Full-bleed edge-to-edge artwork: no border, no cream margin, no white matting, no picture frame. Quiet, photographic, shallow depth of field.
images.usage: Facebook + X (16:9). LinkedIn and Instagram take the full carousel.
images.qa: Approved on the first roll. Reads as the physical work that decides the date — open ceiling void, cable tray, an AP still unmounted in its bracket. Palette, no-text and full-bleed guards all held.
